decisions.statement: A line is a path, a tab, then the value that page takes.
A line holding no tab is refused rather than read as a path alone.
An empty line is passed over rather than refused.
Naming no page is refused rather than answered as no edit.
The edits are worked out by the change reached.
Nothing here reads a page's own body.

definition: one value put under one key on each page a line names
